description: Source code for a documentation and repository management tool that clones repositories, generates mkdocs documentation, and optionally deploys it. Contains classes for YAML generation and main script logic for repository handling and documentation creation.

classes.name: MkdocsYamlFileGenerator
classes.description: Class responsible for creating and writing mkdocs YAML configuration files with topics and subtopics.

classes.name: DocumentGenerator
classes.description: Main class that manages repository cloning, documentation generation, and deployment processes.

methods.name: create_site_details
methods.description: Writes site name and URL to the YAML file.

methods.name: add_nav_tag
methods.description: Adds navigation tag to the YAML file.

methods.name: add_topic
methods.description: Adds a topic section to the YAML file.

methods.name: add_subtopic
methods.description: Adds a subtopic under the current topic in the YAML file.

methods.name: create_topics
methods.description: Creates a new topic in the internal dictionary.

methods.name: create_subtopics
methods.description: Creates a subtopic entry for the current topic.

methods.name: create_file
methods.description: Generates the complete YAML configuration file.

methods.name: is_branch_name_valid
methods.description: Validates the branch name against a semantic version pattern.

methods.name: clone_repo
methods.description: Clones a specific repository and returns commit ID and date.

methods.name: mkdocs_create_index_file
methods.description: Creates the main index.md file with repository info.

methods.name: add_topic
methods.description: Adds a documentation topic and its files to the YAML generator.

methods.name: to_markdown
methods.description: Runs an external script to generate markdown documentation from JSON files.

methods.name: complete_yaml_creation
methods.description: Finalizes and writes the YAML configuration file.
